Rubio to Attend G20 Foreign Ministers Meeting, Meet Brazil's FM

U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio planned to attend the G20 meeting of foreign ministers, where he was expected to outline the Trump administration's diplomatic plans. He also agreed to meet with Brazil's foreign minister following high election tensions in Brazil. Sky News provided a link to watch Rubio speak after the meeting.
